ideas.name: Order and Trade Flow Imbalance
ideas.claim: Combined order-flow and trade-flow imbalances predict short-horizon BTC perpetual futures returns.
ideas.quote: The imbalances jointly explain roughly 7.5% of out-of-sample return variation at the 100-millisecond horizon, deeper levels adding a small further gain.

rules.timeframe: 100-millisecond data; prediction horizons from 100 milliseconds to 10 minutes

ideas.claimed_result: Approximately 7.5% of out-of-sample return variation explained at the 100-millisecond horizon; the paper reports no economically meaningful advantage beyond 30 seconds.
required_data: BTC/USDT perpetual futures order-book data at 100-millisecond resolution
